_README: Six contrasting scenarios. fixtures/ held three files with no per-module
subdirectory convention before this, so fixtures/surface_architecture/ is a new
precedent, stated here rather than assumed.
The point of the set is falsification: a resolver that encoded one flow family
would produce the same archetype for most of these. Each entry declares the
outcome and archetype it must produce, and tools/test_surface_architecture.py
asserts BOTH, so a fixture cannot silently drift into agreeing with the code.
'expect_archetype': null means the resolver must name NO archetype.
A field absent from a context is absent on purpose -- it is a fact nobody
measured, and the resolver must refuse rather than assume.

consumer-anonymous-value._why: A consumer tool that can produce a real result before anyone is known. Work precedes a durable owner and survives interruption.

context.first_meaningful_value: a finished artifact the party can keep

b2b-invitation._why: Entry is predicated on an invitation that already carries the organisation and the role. Asking for what the invitation answered is the failure mode.

context.first_meaningful_value: seeing the work they were invited to

integration-first-devtool._why: One authorised connection resolves dozens of facts at once. Progress collapse is the whole reason this topology exists.

context.primary_intent: see their own work in the product

document-heavy-consequential._why: The QuickLease shape. An artifact the party already holds seeds the work and resolves many facts, but every extracted fact is consequential and must carry provenance.

context.first_meaningful_value: a draft built from what they already hold

regulated-high-assurance._why: A verified party is required before the product acts. Every value-before-identity topology is disqualified by a measured fact, not by preference. THIS EXPECTATION WAS WRONG ON ITS FIRST RUN: it declared ABSTAIN and the resolver returned REQUIRE_APPROVAL. The resolver was right. A regulated, high-assurance product with consequences outside itself is exactly the case a machine may propose and may not choose. The expectation was corrected; the code was not.

residual-only-no-topology._why: The OTHER refusal, and it is not the same as the underspecified one. Everything material was measured; the facts simply select nothing. No value before identity, no work before identity, no artifact, no integration, no invitation, no returning population, and nothing requires a known party. Every specific archetype is disqualified by a measured fact and only the zero-requirement residual survives. That is a statement about the PRODUCT. The underspecified fixture below is a statement about the MEASUREMENT, and conflating the two is the failure this resolver's fourth outcome exists to prevent.

context.product_kind: a product whose entry facts select nothing
context.first_meaningful_value: an outcome only reachable after commitment

adversarial-underspecified._why: The refusal case. Three material facts were measured and one was not. The resolver must name the gap and decline, not pick the archetype the other three suggest.
